hints.title: Single Index Tracking
hints.text: The permutation returns to initial identity as soon as a single non-fixed element like index 1 returns to its initial spot.

hints.title: Index Mapping Formula
hints.text: At each step, index i maps to 2 * i if 2 * i < n, else 2 * i - (n - 1).

hints.title: Modular Doubling Cycle
hints.text: For element 1, the index updates as (2 * index) % (n - 1) until it cycles back to 1.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rebuilding and comparing the entire array of size n at each step wastes O(n^2) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking index 1 with arithmetic doubling takes constant auxiliary space and O(n) steps.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes cycle length of element 1 characterizes the full permutation cycle.
